# Welcome to Persistence Survival. This server is not affiliated with the official Persistence SS14 server.
Uptimes are posted on the discord.
The rules are to be enforced as intended, not literally written.
# Server Rules
##1: Respect Others - 1.1 Treat other players with respect. - 1.2 Do not harass, insult, or intentionally ruin other players’ experience.
##2: Use Common Sense ##2.1: ERP will not be tolerated under any circumstances.
##3: Self-Antags - 3.1 You are permitted to be an antagonist if you wish - 3.2 You must have a good reason to murder someone - 3.3 Round Removing (Gibbing or other means) is not allowed - 3.4 If you do kill someone, make a reasonable effort to leave them in a revivable state. (Body bags, leaving them somewhere they can be found) - 3.5 Mass destruction should be avoided unless you have a very good reason
##4: Stations with a cryo on them should generally be considered safe zones.
##5: English - This is an english server, speak english
##6: New Life Rule - If your character dies and you respawn as a new character, you may not reuse the same name or a very similar one, and you may not act on knowledge from your previous life. ###6.1 Death Amnesia You may not remember highly specific details about your death. Ex. You may know that a human in dark clothing attacked you but not John Space killed you.
##7: Metacommunications - You should not be revealing major secrets or information that should not be known by others or something like that idk.
